To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
adversarial training and data augmentation can improve the robustness and accuracy of task oriented intent slot tagging models.
adversarial training and data augmentation can be used to increase the robustness of task oriented language understanding systems.

1) adversarial training improves the robustness of intent detection and slot tagging models, 2) data augmentation using back-translation improves the robustness, and 3) combining the two techniques yields the best results.
In summary, our research is concerned with
improving the robustness of a task oriented dialog system by improving the robustness to small changes in input.
improving the robustness of task-oriented dialog systems by making the models more robust to adversarial examples and improving the robustness to small variations in queries.
improving the accuracy and robustness of task oriented dialog systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our adversarial training and data augmentation approaches improve the robustness and accuracy of intent and slot tagging in a task oriented dialog system.
our adversarial training and back translation methods are able to substantially improve the robustness and performance of the intent detection and slot tagging models.
adversarial training is a good way to improve the robustness, but it is also a good idea to use back translation for data augmentation to further improve the performance of the system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we show how to create an automated adversarial test set for language understanding in dialog, how to evaluate the robustness of a model on that set, how to improve the robustness using data augmentation and how to improve it using adversarial training.
we have developed a method to evaluate robustness of intent slot models and have shown that both data augmentation and adversarial training improve robustness of the models.

we propose an adversarial test dataset to evaluate the robustness of task-oriented language understanding models and we show that both adversarial training and data augmentation using back-translation can improve the robustness and the overall performance of such models.
The main takeaway from our work is that
robustness is an important factor to consider when building task-oriented dialog systems.
robustness of task oriented dialog systems should be evaluated using an adversarial testset and improved using adversarial training.
the robustness of task oriented dialog systems can be improved using adversarial techniques and data augmentation.
